column2: An organized collection of data. In class: Kütüphane kitaplarını takip etmek için bir veri tabanı kullanır. (The library uses a database to track its books.)

column1: 表の形で数を計算・整理するソフト。授業では Sonuçları elektronik tabloya girin.(結果をスプレッドシートに入力しよう)
column2: Software that calculates and organizes numbers in a table. In class: Sonuçları elektronik tabloya girin. (Enter the results in the spreadsheet.)

column1: 表の横の並び。授業では Her satırda bir öğrenci var.(それぞれの行が生徒1人を表している)
column2: A line of cells across a table. In class: Her satırda bir öğrenci var. (Each row shows one student.)

column1: 表のたての並び。授業では Tarih için yeni bir sütun ekleyin.(日付のための新しい列を足そう)
column2: A line of cells down a table. In class: Tarih için yeni bir sütun ekleyin. (Add a new column for the date.)

column1: 決まった順番に並べる。授業では Listeyi büyükten küçüğe sıralayın.(リストを大きい順に並べ替えよう)
column2: To put in order. In class: Listeyi büyükten küçüğe sıralayın. (Sort the list from highest to lowest.)

column1: 条件に合うデータだけを表示する。授業では Yalnızca bu yılı göstermek için verileri filtreleyin.(今年の分だけ表示するようにデータを絞り込もう)
column2: To show only the data that matches. In class: Yalnızca bu yılı göstermek için verileri filtreleyin. (Filter the data to show only this year.)

column2: A graph with bars for amounts. In class: Sütun grafiği miktarları karşılaştırmak için uygundur. (A bar graph is good for comparing amounts.)

column2: A circle graph that shows parts of a whole. In class: Daire grafiği, zamanımızı nasıl geçirdiğimizi gösterir. (The pie chart shows how we spend our time.)

column1: 時間による変化を線で表すグラフ。授業では Bir haftalık sıcaklığı göstermek için çizgi grafiği kullanın.(1週間の気温を表すには折れ線グラフを使おう)
column2: A graph with a line that shows change over time. In class: Bir haftalık sıcaklığı göstermek için çizgi grafiği kullanın. (Use a line graph to show the temperature over a week.)

column2: Asking many people questions. In class: Bütün sınıfla bir anket yapacağız. (We'll do a survey of the whole class.)

column1: データ全体の動きの方向。授業では Bu grafikte nasıl bir eğilim görüyorsunuz?(このグラフからどんな傾向が見えるかな?)
column2: The direction the data is moving. In class: Bu grafikte nasıl bir eğilim görüyorsunuz? (What trend do you see in this graph?)

column1: 一方が変わるともう一方も変わる関係。授業では Uyku ile sınav puanları arasında bir korelasyon var.(睡眠とテストの点数には相関がある)
column2: When one thing changes together with another. In class: Uyku ile sınav puanları arasında bir korelasyon var. (There is a correlation between sleep and test scores.)

column1: 人のように学んだり判断したりするコンピューターの技術。授業では Yapay zekâ dilleri çevirebilir.(人工知能は言葉を翻訳できる)
column2: Computers that learn and decide like people. In class: Yapay zekâ dilleri çevirebilir. (Artificial intelligence can translate languages.)

column1: コンピューターがデータからルールを学ぶこと。授業では Makine öğrenmesi devasa verilerde örüntüler bulur.(機械学習は大量のデータからパターンを見つける)
column2: Computers learning rules from data. In class: Makine öğrenmesi devasa verilerde örüntüler bulur. (Machine learning finds patterns in huge amounts of data.)

column1: 自分の情報を勝手に知られたり使われたりしないこと。授業では Kaydolmadan önce gizlilik ayarlarını okuyun.(登録する前にプライバシー設定を読もう)
column2: Keeping your information to yourself. In class: Kaydolmadan önce gizlilik ayarlarını okuyun. (Read the privacy settings before you sign up.)

column1: ふつうでは扱いきれないほど大量のデータ。授業では Mağazalar insanların ne alacağını tahmin etmek için büyük veri kullanır.(お店はビッグデータを使って人が何を買うか予測する)
column2: Huge amounts of data. In class: Mağazalar insanların ne alacağını tahmin etmek için büyük veri kullanır. (Stores use big data to predict what people will buy.)

column1: 体を動かすために縮んだりゆるんだりする組織。授業では Koşmadan önce bacak kaslarınızı esnetin.(走る前に脚の筋肉を伸ばそう)
column2: The tissue that moves the body. In class: Koşmadan önce bacak kaslarınızı esnetin. (Stretch your leg muscles before running.)

column1: 体を支え、内臓を守るかたいもの。授業では Kalsiyum kemikleri güçlendirir.(カルシウムは骨を強くする)
column2: The hard part that holds up the body. In class: Kalsiyum kemikleri güçlendirir. (Calcium makes your bones strong.)

column2: Where two bones meet. In class: Diz bir eklemdir. (Your knee is a joint.)

column1: 体全体の骨の組み立て。授業では İnsan iskeleti yaklaşık 206 kemikten oluşur.(人の骨格にはおよそ206個の骨がある)
column2: All the bones of the body. In class: İnsan iskeleti yaklaşık 206 kemikten oluşur. (The human skeleton has about 206 bones.)

column1: 筋肉と骨をつなぐ丈夫なひも。授業では Aşil tendonu ayak bileğinin arkasındadır.(アキレス腱は足首の後ろにある)
column2: The strong cord that joins a muscle to a bone. In class: Aşil tendonu ayak bileğinin arkasındadır. (The Achilles tendon is at the back of your ankle.)

column1: 1分間に心臓が打つ回数。授業では Koştuktan sonra nabzınızı ölçün.(走ったあとに心拍数を測ろう)
column2: How many times the heart beats in a minute. In class: Koştuktan sonra nabzınızı ölçün. (Check your heart rate after the run.)

column1: 空気を吸って酸素を取り入れる臓器。授業では Derin nefes almak akciğerlerinizi havayla doldurur.(深呼吸すると肺が空気で満たされる)
column2: The organs you breathe with. In class: Derin nefes almak akciğerlerinizi havayla doldurur. (Deep breathing fills your lungs with air.)

column1: 脳から体へ命令や感覚を伝えるしくみ。授業では Sinir sistemi beyinden mesajlar gönderir.(神経系は脳からの信号を伝える)
column2: The system that carries messages from the brain. In class: Sinir sistemi beyinden mesajlar gönderir. (The nervous system sends messages from the brain.)

column1: 子どもから大人の体に変わっていく時期。授業では Ergenlikte vücudunuz çok değişir.(思春期には体が大きく変わる)
column2: The time when a child's body becomes an adult's. In class: Ergenlikte vücudunuz çok değişir. (Your body changes a lot during puberty.)

column1: 急に背が伸びる時期。授業では Birçok erkek on dört ya da on beş yaşında hızlı bir büyüme dönemi geçirir.(多くの男子は14歳か15歳ごろに急に背が伸びる)
column2: A time of growing fast. In class: Birçok erkek on dört ya da on beş yaşında hızlı bir büyüme dönemi geçirir. (Many boys have a growth spurt at fourteen or fifteen.)

column1: 体の働きを調節する物質。授業では Hormonlar vücudun nasıl büyüdüğünü kontrol eder.(ホルモンは体の成長をコントロールしている)
column2: A substance that controls how the body works. In class: Hormonlar vücudun nasıl büyüdüğünü kontrol eder. (Hormones control how your body grows.)

column1: 病気のもとから体を守るしくみ。授業では İyi uyku bağışıklık sisteminize yardımcı olur.(よく眠ると免疫の働きが助けられる)
column2: What protects the body from germs. In class: İyi uyku bağışıklık sisteminize yardımcı olur. (Good sleep helps your immune system.)

column1: 食べたものをエネルギーに変える体の働き。授業では Egzersiz metabolizmanızı hızlandırır.(運動は代謝を活発にする)
column2: How the body turns food into energy. In class: Egzersiz metabolizmanızı hızlandırır. (Exercise speeds up your metabolism.)

column1: 食べ物のエネルギーの量を表す単位。授業では Sporcuların diğer insanlardan daha fazla kaloriye ihtiyacı vardır.(運動選手はほかの人よりたくさんのカロリーが必要だ)
column2: A unit for the energy in food. In class: Sporcuların diğer insanlardan daha fazla kaloriye ihtiyacı vardır. (Athletes need more calories than other people.)

column1: 体に必要な、食べ物にふくまれる成分。授業では Sebzeler besin öğeleriyle doludur.(野菜には栄養素がたくさんふくまれている)
column2: What in food the body needs. In class: Sebzeler besin öğeleriyle doludur. (Vegetables are full of nutrients.)

column1: 筋肉や血をつくる栄養素。授業では Kas yapmak için protein yiyin.(筋肉をつけるにはたんぱく質をとろう)
column2: A nutrient that builds muscle. In class: Kas yapmak için protein yiyin. (Eat protein to build muscle.)

column1: いろいろな栄養素をほどよくとる食事。授業では Dengeli beslenmede meyve, sebze ve tahıl bulunur.(バランスのよい食事には果物・野菜・穀物が入る)
column2: Meals with the right mix of nutrients. In class: Dengeli beslenmede meyve, sebze ve tahıl bulunur. (A balanced diet includes fruit, vegetables and grains.)

column1: 体に必要な水分をとること。授業では Sıcak günlerde sıvı alımı önemlidir.(暑い日は水分補給が大切だ)
column2: Drinking the water your body needs. In class: Sıcak günlerde sıvı alımı önemlidir. (Hydration is important on hot days.)

column1: 気持ちや心の状態の健康。授業では Bir arkadaşla konuşmak ruh sağlığına iyi gelir.(友だちに話すことは心の健康の助けになる)
column2: The health of your mind and feelings. In class: Bir arkadaşla konuşmak ruh sağlığına iyi gelir. (Talking to a friend can help your mental health.)

column2: Pressure on the mind and body. In class: Egzersiz, stresle başa çıkmanın iyi bir yoludur. (Exercise is a good way to deal with stress.)

column2: Keeping yourself and things around you clean. In class: İyi hijyen mikropların yayılmasını önler. (Good hygiene stops germs from spreading.)

column2: Germs getting into the body and multiplying. In class: Enfeksiyonu önlemek için kesiği yıkayın. (Wash the cut to prevent infection.)

column1: 病気にかかりにくくするために打つ薬。授業では Aşı, vücudunuzun bir virüsle savaşmasına yardım eder.(ワクチンは体がウイルスと戦うのを助ける)
column2: A shot that helps the body fight a disease. In class: Aşı, vücudunuzun bir virüsle savaşmasına yardım eder. (A vaccine helps your body fight a virus.)

column2: Feeling you must do what your friends do. In class: Akran baskısına hayır demekte bir sakınca yok. (It's okay to say no to peer pressure.)

column2: Help given on the spot to someone hurt or ill. In class: Herkes temel ilk yardımı öğrenmeli. (Everyone should learn basic first aid.)

column1: 胸を押して心臓と呼吸を助ける救命の方法。授業では Kalp-akciğer canlandırma sırasında göğsün ortasına güçlü ve hızlı bastırın.(心肺蘇生では胸の真ん中を強く速く押す)
column2: Pushing on the chest to help someone whose heart has stopped. In class: Kalp-akciğer canlandırma sırasında göğsün ortasına güçlü ve hızlı bastırın. (Push hard and fast in the center of the chest during CPR.)

column2: A machine that gives an electric shock to restart the heart. In class: Defibrilatör, sesli komutlarla ne yapacağınızı söyler. (The AED tells you what to do with voice instructions.)

column2: An injury from twisting a joint. In class: Ayak bileğinde burkulma var. (He has a sprain in his ankle.)

column2: A blue mark under the skin after a hit. In class: Morluğa buz koyun. (Put ice on the bruise.)

column2: Blood coming out. In class: Kanamayı durdurmak için yaraya sıkıca bastırın. (Press firmly on the wound to stop the bleeding.)

column2: Getting sick when the body gets too hot. In class: Sıcak çarpmasından korunmak için gölgede dinlenin. (Take breaks in the shade to avoid heatstroke.)

column2: Rest, ice, compression and elevation. In class: Burkulmada RICE yöntemini hatırlayın: dinlenme, buz, sıkıştırma ve yükseltme. (For a sprain, remember RICE: rest, ice, compression and elevation.)

column2: The strength to keep going for a long time. In class: Uzun mesafe koşusu dayanıklılık kazandırır. (Long-distance running builds endurance.)

column1: 体がやわらかく、関節がよく動くこと。授業では Her gün esneme yapmak esnekliği artırır.(毎日のストレッチで柔軟性が上がる)
column2: How easily your body bends. In class: Her gün esneme yapmak esnekliği artırır. (Stretching every day improves flexibility.)

column2: How quickly you can move and change direction. In class: Bu merdiven çalışması çevikliğinizi geliştirir. (This ladder drill trains your agility.)

column2: Light exercise after sport. In class: Antrenmandan sonra soğuma hareketlerini atlamayın. (Don't skip the cool-down after practice.)

column2: Running a short distance at full speed. In class: Üç kez elli metre sürat koşusu yapacağız. (We'll sprint fifty meters three times.)

column2: A race where team members run in turn. In class: Bayrak yarışında sopayı düzgünce verin. (Pass the baton smoothly in the relay.)

column2: Jumping as far as you can after a run-up. In class: Uzun atlamada tahtadan sıçrayın. (Take off from the board in the long jump.)

column2: Breaking a rule in a game. In class: İtmek fauldür. (Pushing is a foul.)

column2: A punishment for breaking a rule. In class: Takım geç kaldığı için ceza aldı. (The team got a penalty for being late.)

column2: The side trying to score. In class: Hücumda daha fazla oyuncuya ihtiyacımız var. (We need more players on offense.)

column2: The side trying to stop the other team scoring. In class: İyi savunma maç kazandırır. (Good defense wins games.)

column2: Fair play and respect. In class: Maçtan sonra tokalaşmak sportmenliği gösterir. (Shaking hands after the game shows good sportsmanship.)

column2: A game ending with the same score. In class: Maç beraberlikle bitti. (The game ended in a tie.)

column2: A competition with many teams. In class: Takımımız turnuvanın finaline kaldı. (Our team made it to the final of the tournament.)

column1: ボールをついたり蹴ったりしながら進む。授業では Topu parmak uçlarınızla sürün.(指先でボールをドリブルしよう)
column2: To move the ball by bouncing or kicking it. In class: Topu parmak uçlarınızla sürün. (Dribble the ball with your fingertips.)

column1: はね返ったボールを取ること。授業では Yükseğe zıplayın ve ribauntu alın.(高くとんでリバウンドを取ろう)
column2: Catching a ball that bounces back. In class: Yükseğe zıplayın ve ribauntu alın. (Jump high and grab the rebound.)

column1: 反則のあとに与えられる、じゃまされないシュート。授業では İki serbest atışı da sayıya çevirdi.(彼女はフリースローを2本とも決めた)
column2: An open shot after a foul. In class: İki serbest atışı da sayıya çevirdi. (She made both free throws.)

column1: ボールを打って試合を始めること。授業では Servis sırası sizde.(あなたがサーブする番だ)
column2: To hit the ball to start play. In class: Servis sırası sizde. (It's your turn to serve.)

column1: バレーボールで高い位置から強く打ちこむこと。授業では Smaç vurabilmesi için topu yükseğe kaldırın.(彼女がスパイクできるようにボールを高く上げよう)
column2: A hard downward hit in volleyball. In class: Smaç vurabilmesi için topu yükseğe kaldırın. (Set the ball high so she can spike it.)

column1: ゴールを守る選手。授業では Kaleci ceza sahasında elleriyle oynayabilir.(ゴールキーパーはエリア内で手を使える)
column2: The player who guards the goal. In class: Kaleci ceza sahasında elleriyle oynayabilir. (The goalkeeper can use her hands in the box.)

column1: サッカーで頭でボールを打つこと。授業では Kafa vuruşuyla gol attı.(彼はヘディングで得点した)
column2: Hitting the ball with your head. In class: Kafa vuruşuyla gol attı. (He scored with a header.)

column1: ボールの打ち合いが続くこと。授業では Ne uzun bir ralliydi!(長いラリーだったね!)
column2: A long exchange of hits. In class: Ne uzun bir ralliydi! (That was a long rally!)

column1: ふつうはクロールで泳ぐ種目。授業では 25 metre serbest stil yüzün.(自由形で25メートル泳ごう)
column2: Usually the front crawl. In class: 25 metre serbest stil yüzün. (Swim 25 meters freestyle.)

column1: カエルのように足で水をけって泳ぐ泳ぎ方。授業では Kurbağalamada kurbağa gibi ayak vurun.(平泳ぎではカエルのようにけろう)
column2: Swimming with a frog-like kick. In class: Kurbağalamada kurbağa gibi ayak vurun. (Kick like a frog in the breaststroke.)

column1: あお向けで泳ぐ泳ぎ方。授業では Sırtüstü yüzerken tavana bakın.(背泳ぎのときは天井を見よう)
column2: Swimming on your back. In class: Sırtüstü yüzerken tavana bakın. (Look up at the ceiling when you do the backstroke.)

column1: 両腕を同時に回して泳ぐ泳ぎ方。授業では Kelebek en zor yüzme stilidir.(バタフライはいちばん難しい泳ぎ方だ)
column2: Swimming with both arms moving together. In class: Kelebek en zor yüzme stilidir. (The butterfly is the hardest stroke.)

column1: 前に転がる運動。授業では Öne takla için çenenizi göğsünüze yapıştırın.(前転ではあごを引こう)
column2: Rolling forward. In class: Öne takla için çenenizi göğsünüze yapıştırın. (Tuck your chin in for a forward roll.)

column1: 手で体を支えて逆さに立つこと。授業では Amutta beş saniye durun.(倒立を5秒キープしよう)
column2: Standing upside down on your hands. In class: Amutta beş saniye durun. (Hold the handstand for five seconds.)

column1: 手をついてとびこす台。授業では Koşun, sıçrayın ve atlama kasasından elinizle itin.(走って、とんで、跳び箱を手でつき放そう)
column2: A box you jump over with your hands. In class: Koşun, sıçrayın ve atlama kasasından elinizle itin. (Run, jump and push off the vaulting box.)

column1: 細い台の上でバランスをとって演技する器具。授業では Denge aletinin üzerinde yavaşça yürüyün.(平均台の上をゆっくり歩こう)
column2: A narrow beam for balance exercises. In class: Denge aletinin üzerinde yavaşça yürüyün. (Walk slowly across the balance beam.)

column1: 音符を書く5本の線。授業では Notaları porteye yazın.(五線に音符を書こう)
column2: The five lines that music is written on. In class: Notaları porteye yazın. (Write the notes on the staff.)

column1: 高い音の楽譜の始めに書く記号。授業では Melodi sol anahtarıyla yazılmıştır.(旋律はト音記号の楽譜で書かれている)
column2: The sign at the start of high notes. In class: Melodi sol anahtarıyla yazılmıştır. (The melody is written in the treble clef.)

column1: 低い音の楽譜の始めに書く記号。授業では Sol el fa anahtarını okur.(左手はヘ音記号の楽譜を読む)
column2: The sign at the start of low notes. In class: Sol el fa anahtarını okur. (The left hand reads the bass clef.)

column1: 1拍分の長さの音符。授業では Dörtlük nota bir vuruştur.(四分音符は1拍だ)
column2: A note one beat long. In class: Dörtlük nota bir vuruştur. (A quarter note gets one beat.)

column1: 2拍分の長さの音符。授業では İkilik notayı iki vuruş boyunca uzatın.(二分音符は2拍のばそう)
column2: A note two beats long. In class: İkilik notayı iki vuruş boyunca uzatın. (Hold the half note for two beats.)

column1: 音を出さずに休む長さを表す記号。授業では Es sırasında çalmayın.(休符のところでは演奏しないで)
column2: A sign for silence. In class: Es sırasında çalmayın. (Don't play during the rest.)

column1: 半音上げる記号。授業では Fa diyez, fa'dan yarım ton daha incedir.(Fシャープは F より半音高い)
column2: A sign that raises a note by a half step. In class: Fa diyez, fa'dan yarım ton daha incedir. (F sharp is a half step higher than F.)

column1: 1小節に何拍あるかを表す記号。授業では Bu şarkı üç dörtlük ölçüde.(この曲は4分の3拍子だ)
column2: The sign that shows how many beats are in a measure. In class: Bu şarkı üç dörtlük ölçüde. (This song has a three-four time signature.)

column1: 半音下げる記号。授業では Si bemol, si'den yarım ton daha kalındır.(Bフラットは B より半音低い)
column2: A sign that lowers a note by a half step. In class: Si bemol, si'den yarım ton daha kalındır. (B flat is a half step lower than B.)

column1: 楽譜を縦線で区切ったひとまとまり。授業では On ikinci ölçüden yeniden başlayalım.(12小節目からもう一度始めよう)
column2: A section of music between two bar lines. In class: On ikinci ölçüden yeniden başlayalım. (Let's start again from measure twelve.)

column1: 音楽の一定の刻み。授業では Her vuruşta el çırpın.(毎拍、手をたたこう)
column2: The steady pulse of music. In class: Her vuruşta el çırpın. (Clap on every beat.)

column1: 曲の速さ。授業では Başta tempo yavaştır.(最初はテンポがゆっくりだ)
column2: How fast the music goes. In class: Başta tempo yavaştır. (The tempo is slow at the beginning.)

column1: ドレミファソラシドのように順に並んだ音。授業では Do majör gamını çalın.(ハ長調の音階を弾こう)
column2: Notes in order, like do re mi. In class: Do majör gamını çalın. (Play the C major scale.)

column1: 明るい感じの調。授業では Bu şarkı majör tonda, bu yüzden neşeli duyulur.(この曲は長調なので明るく聞こえる)
column2: A key that sounds bright. In class: Bu şarkı majör tonda, bu yüzden neşeli duyulur. (This song is in a major key, so it sounds happy.)

column1: 暗い・悲しい感じの調。授業では Minör tonlar çoğu zaman hüzünlü duyulur.(短調はよく悲しく聞こえる)
column2: A key that sounds dark or sad. In class: Minör tonlar çoğu zaman hüzünlü duyulur. (Minor keys often sound sad.)

column1: 高さのちがう音を同時に鳴らしたもの。授業では Do akorunu üç parmakla çalın.(3本の指で C のコードを弾こう)
column2: Notes played together. In class: Do akorunu üç parmakla çalın. (Play the C chord with three fingers.)

column1: 弦をはじいたりこすったりして音を出す楽器。授業では Keman telli bir çalgıdır.(バイオリンは弦楽器だ)
column2: An instrument played by plucking or bowing strings. In class: Keman telli bir çalgıdır. (The violin is a string instrument.)

column1: フルートやクラリネットなど、息で鳴らす楽器(金属製もある)。授業では Flüt metal olsa da tahta üflemeli bir çalgıdır.(フルートは金属でできていても木管楽器だ)
column2: An instrument you blow, like a flute or clarinet. In class: Flüt metal olsa da tahta üflemeli bir çalgıdır. (The flute is a woodwind instrument, even though it's metal.)

column1: くちびるをふるわせて鳴らす金属の楽器。授業では Trompet bakır üflemeli bir çalgıdır.(トランペットは金管楽器だ)
column2: A metal instrument played by buzzing the lips. In class: Trompet bakır üflemeli bir çalgıdır. (The trumpet is a brass instrument.)

column1: たたいたりふったりして音を出す楽器。授業では Davullar vurmalı çalgılardır.(ドラムは打楽器だ)
column2: An instrument played by hitting or shaking. In class: Davullar vurmalı çalgılardır. (Drums are percussion instruments.)

column1: ピアノのように鍵盤で弾く楽器。授業では Org tuşlu bir çalgıdır.(オルガンは鍵盤楽器だ)
column2: An instrument with keys, like a piano. In class: Org tuşlu bir çalgıdır. (The organ is a keyboard instrument.)

column1: 学校でよく使うたて笛。授業では Blok flütünüzün bütün deliklerini kapatın.(リコーダーの穴を全部ふさごう)
column2: A simple wooden or plastic flute used at school. In class: Blok flütünüzün bütün deliklerini kapatın. (Cover all the holes on your recorder.)

column1: 合奏や合唱をまとめる人。授業では Tempo için şefi takip edin.(テンポは指揮者を見てとろう)
column2: The person who leads the orchestra or choir. In class: Tempo için şefi takip edin. (Watch the conductor for the tempo.)

column1: 弦・管・打楽器がそろった大きな合奏団。授業では Orkestrada yaklaşık seksen müzisyen var.(そのオーケストラには約80人の演奏者がいる)
column2: A large group of string, wind and percussion players. In class: Orkestrada yaklaşık seksen müzisyen var. (The orchestra has about eighty players.)

column1: 楽器の音の高さを正しく合わせる。授業では Başlamadan önce gitarınızı akort edin.(始める前にギターをチューニングしよう)
column2: To set an instrument to the right pitch. In class: Başlamadan önce gitarınızı akort edin. (Tune your guitar before we start.)

column1: バイオリンなどの弦をこする道具。授業では Yayı hafifçe tutun.(弓は軽く持とう)
column2: The stick you draw across the strings. In class: Yayı hafifçe tutun. (Hold the bow lightly.)

column1: 楽器に張られた、ふるえて音を出す線。授業では Tellerden biri akortsuz.(弦の1本の音がずれている)
column2: A wire that vibrates to make sound. In class: Tellerden biri akortsuz. (One of the strings is out of tune.)

column1: 管楽器の口をあてる部分。授業では Çaldıktan sonra ağızlığı temizleyin.(吹いたあとはマウスピースをきれいにしよう)
column2: The part of a wind instrument you put your mouth on. In class: Çaldıktan sonra ağızlığı temizleyin. (Clean the mouthpiece after you play.)

column1: クラリネットなどで、ふるえて音を出す薄い板。授業では Çalmadan önce kamışı ıslatın.(吹く前にリードをしめらせよう)
column2: A thin piece that vibrates in a clarinet or similar. In class: Çalmadan önce kamışı ıslatın. (Wet the reed before you play.)

column1: 金管楽器で音の高さを変えるために押す部分。授業では Bu nota için birinci pistona basın.(この音は1番のピストンを押そう)
column2: A button on a brass instrument that changes the pitch. In class: Bu nota için birinci pistona basın. (Press the first valve for this note.)

column1: ピアノなどで足でふむ部分。授業では Notaların daha uzun tınlaması için pedalı kullanın.(音を長く響かせるにはペダルを使おう)
column2: A part you press with your foot. In class: Notaların daha uzun tınlaması için pedalı kullanın. (Use the pedal to make the notes ring longer.)

column1: 木琴などをたたく、先が丸い棒。授業では Ksilofona bagetle hafifçe vurun.(マレットで木琴をやさしくたたこう)
column2: A stick with a round head for hitting a xylophone. In class: Ksilofona bagetle hafifçe vurun. (Hit the xylophone gently with the mallet.)

column1: 音の大きさの変化。授業では Bu bölümdeki gürlük işaretlerine dikkat edin.(この部分では強弱に気をつけよう)
column2: How loud or soft the music is. In class: Bu bölümdeki gürlük işaretlerine dikkat edin. (Pay attention to the dynamics in this part.)

column1: 強く演奏する記号 f。授業では Bu bölümü forte çalın.(この部分は強く演奏しよう)
column2: Loud (f). In class: Bu bölümü forte çalın. (Play this part forte.)

column1: 少しずつ大きくする。授業では Sona doğru kreşendo yapın.(終わりに向かってだんだん強くしよう)
column2: Getting louder little by little. In class: Sona doğru kreşendo yapın. (Make a crescendo toward the end.)

column1: 少しずつ小さくする。授業では Son satırda dekreşendo yapın.(最後の段はだんだん弱くしよう)
column2: Getting softer little by little. In class: Son satırda dekreşendo yapın. (Do a decrescendo on the last line.)

column1: 音を短く切って演奏する。授業では Noktalar staccato demektir.(点はスタッカートの意味だ)
column2: Short and detached. In class: Noktalar staccato demektir. (The dots mean staccato.)

column1: 音をなめらかにつないで演奏する。授業では Akıcı bir şekilde, legato çalın.(なめらかにレガートで演奏しよう)
column2: Smooth and connected. In class: Akıcı bir şekilde, legato çalın. (Play smoothly, legato.)

column1: その音を特に強く演奏する記号。授業では İlk notaya aksan koyun.(最初の音にアクセントをつけよう)
column2: A sign to play a note strongly. In class: İlk notaya aksan koyun. (Put an accent on the first note.)

column1: その部分をくり返す記号。授業では Tekrar işaretini görünce başa dönün.(反復記号が出たら始めに戻ろう)
column2: A sign to play a part again. In class: Tekrar işaretini görünce başa dönün. (When you see the repeat sign, go back to the beginning.)

column1: 女声のいちばん高いパート。授業では Sopranolar melodiyi söyler.(ソプラノが旋律を歌う)
column2: The highest voice part. In class: Sopranolar melodiyi söyler. (The sopranos sing the melody.)

column1: 女声の低いパート。授業では Altolar biraz daha pes söyler.(アルトは少し低く歌う)
column2: The lower women’s voice part. In class: Altolar biraz daha pes söyler. (The altos sing a little lower.)

column1: 男声の高いパート。授業では Tenorlar sekizinci ölçüde girer.(テノールは8小節目から入る)
column2: The higher men’s voice part. In class: Tenorlar sekizinci ölçüde girer. (The tenors come in at measure eight.)

column1: 男声のいちばん低いパート。授業では Sesim kalın, bu yüzden bas söylüyorum.(声が低いので私はバスを歌う)
column2: The lowest voice part. In class: Sesim kalın, bu yüzden bas söylüyorum. (My voice is low, so I sing bass.)

column1: 音が高いか低いか。授業では Dikkatle dinleyin ve ses perdesini tutturun.(よく聞いて音の高さを合わせよう)
column2: How high or low a sound is. In class: Dikkatle dinleyin ve ses perdesini tutturun. (Listen carefully and match the pitch.)

column1: 全員が同じ旋律を歌う。授業では İlk kıtayı unison söyleyelim.(1番はみんな同じ旋律で歌おう)
column2: All on the same melody. In class: İlk kıtayı unison söyleyelim. (Let's sing the first verse in unison.)

column1: 歌のことば。授業では Şarkı sözlerini ezbere biliyor musunuz?(歌詞を覚えているかな?)
column2: The words of a song. In class: Şarkı sözlerini ezbere biliyor musunuz? (Do you know the lyrics by heart?)

column1: 歌うときに息を長く安定して使うこと。授業では İyi nefes kontrolü uzun notaları tutmanıza yardım eder.(息の使い方がうまいと長い音をのばせる)
column2: Using your breath steadily when singing. In class: İyi nefes kontrolü uzun notaları tutmanıza yardım eder. (Good breath control helps you hold long notes.)

column1: 西洋で昔から受けつがれてきた芸術音楽。授業では Mozart klasik müzik besteledi.(モーツァルトはクラシック音楽を作った)
column2: The art music of the Western tradition. In class: Mozart klasik müzik besteledi. (Mozart wrote classical music.)

column1: 曲を作る人。授業では Beethoven Alman bir besteciydi.(ベートーヴェンはドイツの作曲家だった)
column2: A person who writes music. In class: Beethoven Alman bir besteciydi. (Beethoven was a German composer.)

column1: オーケストラのための、いくつかの楽章からなる大きな曲。授業では Bir senfoni genellikle dört bölümden oluşur.(交響曲はふつう4つの楽章からなる)
column2: A long piece for orchestra in several movements. In class: Bir senfoni genellikle dört bölümden oluşur. (A symphony usually has four movements.)

column1: 歌とオーケストラで物語を演じる舞台。授業では Operada oyuncular repliklerini şarkıyla söyler.(オペラでは役者がせりふを歌う)
column2: A play that is sung, with an orchestra. In class: Operada oyuncular repliklerini şarkıyla söyler. (In an opera, the actors sing their lines.)

column1: 17〜18世紀前半ごろのヨーロッパの音楽の時代。授業では Bach ünlü bir Barok bestecisidir.(バッハは有名なバロックの作曲家だ)
column2: The period of European music from the 1600s to the mid-1700s. In class: Bach ünlü bir Barok bestecisidir. (Bach is a famous Baroque composer.)

column1: その土地の人々の間で歌いつがれてきた音楽。授業では Her ülkenin kendi halk müziği vardır.(どの国にもその国の民謡がある)
column2: The traditional music of a place. In class: Her ülkenin kendi halk müziği vardır. (Every country has its own folk music.)

column1: アメリカで生まれた、即興演奏が特徴の音楽。授業では Caz New Orleans'ta doğdu.(ジャズはニューオーリンズで生まれた)
column2: Music born in America, known for improvisation. In class: Caz New Orleans'ta doğdu. (Jazz was born in New Orleans.)

column1: 楽譜なしでその場で作りながら演奏する。授業では Caz müzisyenleri sık sık doğaçlama solo yapar.(ジャズの演奏者はよくソロを即興で演奏する)
column2: To make up music while playing. In class: Caz müzisyenleri sık sık doğaçlama solo yapar. (Jazz players often improvise solos.)

column1: 新しい曲を作る。授業では Sekiz ölçülük kısa bir melodi besteleyin.(8小節の短い旋律を作曲しよう)
column2: To write a new piece of music. In class: Sekiz ölçülük kısa bir melodi besteleyin. (Compose a short melody of eight measures.)

column1: 曲を別の楽器や形に合わせて作り直す。授業では Pop şarkısını bando için düzenledi.(彼はそのポップスを吹奏楽用に編曲した)
column2: To rewrite a piece for other instruments or a new style. In class: Pop şarkısını bando için düzenledi. (He arranged the pop song for a brass band.)

column1: 音の高さと長さが続いてできる、曲の歌の部分。授業では Önce melodiyi mırıldanın.(まず旋律をハミングしよう)
column2: The tune of a piece. In class: Önce melodiyi mırıldanın. (Hum the melody first.)

column1: 旋律といっしょに鳴る、ほかの音の重なり。授業では İkinci grup armoniyi söyler.(2つ目のグループはハーモニーを歌う)
column2: Other notes sounding together with the melody. In class: İkinci grup armoniyi söyler. (The second group sings the harmony.)

column1: サビの前の、話を進める部分。授業では Her kıta hikâyenin farklı bir bölümünü anlatır.(それぞれのヴァースが物語の別の部分を語る)
column2: The part of a song before the chorus. In class: Her kıta hikâyenin farklı bir bölümünü anlatır. (Each verse tells a different part of the story.)

column1: 曲の中でくり返される、いちばん印象的な部分。授業では Nakaratta herkes eşlik eder.(サビではみんなが一緒に歌う)
column2: The repeated, catchiest part of a song. In class: Nakaratta herkes eşlik eder. (Everyone joins in on the chorus.)

column1: 後半で雰囲気を変える、一度だけ出てくる部分。授業では Köprü, son nakarattan önce havayı değiştirir.(ブリッジは最後のサビの前に雰囲気を変える)
column2: A part that comes once and changes the mood. In class: Köprü, son nakarattan önce havayı değiştirir. (The bridge changes the mood before the last chorus.)

column1: 音楽をよく聞いて味わい、感じたことを考えること。授業では Müzik dinleme dersinde dinler ve neler hissettiğimizi paylaşırız.(音楽鑑賞では、聞いて感じたことを伝え合う)
column2: Listening closely to music and thinking about it. In class: Müzik dinleme dersinde dinler ve neler hissettiğimizi paylaşırız. (In music appreciation, we listen and share how we feel.)

column1: 大まかにさっと描くこと。授業では Önce kurşun kalemle hızlı bir eskiz yapın.(まず鉛筆でさっとスケッチしよう)
column2: A quick, rough drawing. In class: Önce kurşun kalemle hızlı bir eskiz yapın. (Start with a quick sketch in pencil.)

column1: 明るいところと暗いところを描き分けること。授業では Gölgelendirme elmanın yuvarlak görünmesini sağlar.(陰影をつけるとリンゴが丸く見える)
column2: Drawing the light and dark parts. In class: Gölgelendirme elmanın yuvarlak görünmesini sağlar. (Shading makes the apple look round.)

column1: 形のふちを表す線。授業では Kaleminizi kaldırmadan kontur çizgisini çizin.(鉛筆を離さずに輪郭線を描こう)
column2: The line that shows the edge of a shape. In class: Kaleminizi kaldırmadan kontur çizgisini çizin. (Draw the contour line without lifting your pencil.)

column1: 部分と全体の大きさの関係。授業では Başın vücuda oranını kontrol edin.(頭と体の比率を確かめよう)
column2: The size of the parts compared with the whole. In class: Başın vücuda oranını kontrol edin. (Check the proportion of the head to the body.)

column1: 近くを大きく遠くを小さく描いて奥行きを出す方法。授業では Yolun uzun görünmesi için perspektif kullanın.(遠近法を使って道が長く見えるようにしよう)
column2: Drawing near things big and far things small to show depth. In class: Yolun uzun görünmesi için perspektif kullanın. (Use perspective to make the road look long.)

column1: 遠近法で、線が集まって消える点。授業では Bütün bu çizgiler kaçış noktasında buluşur.(これらの線はすべて消失点で交わる)
column2: The point where lines meet in perspective. In class: Bütün bu çizgiler kaçış noktasında buluşur. (All these lines meet at the vanishing point.)

column1: 果物や花びんなど、動かないものを描いた絵。授業では Bugün meyvelerle bir natürmort yapacağız.(今日は果物の静物画を描く)
column2: A picture of objects that don't move. In class: Bugün meyvelerle bir natürmort yapacağız. (Today we'll paint a still life of fruit.)

column1: 人の顔や姿を描いた絵。授業では Yanınızdaki arkadaşın portresini çizin.(隣の人の肖像画を描こう)
column2: A picture of a person. In class: Yanınızdaki arkadaşın portresini çizin. (Draw a portrait of the person next to you.)

column1: まぜて多くの色を作れるもとの3色(赤・青・黄)。授業では Kırmızı, mavi ve sarı ana renklerdir.(赤・青・黄が三原色だ)
column2: The three colors you mix others from (red, blue, yellow). In class: Kırmızı, mavi ve sarı ana renklerdir. (Red, blue and yellow are the primary colors.)

column1: 三原色を2つまぜてできる色。授業では İki ana rengi karıştırarak bir ara renk elde edin.(三原色を2つまぜると二次色ができる)
column2: Colors made by mixing two primary colors. In class: İki ana rengi karıştırarak bir ara renk elde edin. (Mix two primary colors to get a secondary color.)

column1: 色相環で向かい合う、たがいを引き立てる色。授業では Turuncu ve mavi tamamlayıcı renklerdir.(オレンジと青は補色だ)
column2: Colors opposite each other on the color wheel. In class: Turuncu ve mavi tamamlayıcı renklerdir. (Orange and blue are complementary colors.)

column1: 赤・オレンジ・黄など、あたたかく感じる色。授業では Sıcak renkler odayı sıcacık gösterir.(暖色は部屋を居心地よく感じさせる)
column2: Red, orange and yellow. In class: Sıcak renkler odayı sıcacık gösterir. (Warm colors make the room feel cozy.)

column1: 青・緑・紫など、すずしく感じる色。授業では Deniz soğuk renklerle boyanmış.(海は寒色で描かれている)
column2: Blue, green and purple. In class: Deniz soğuk renklerle boyanmış. (The sea is painted in cool colors.)

column1: 色を順番に円に並べたもの。授業では Renk çemberinde yeşili bulun.(色相環で緑を見つけよう)
column2: Colors arranged in a circle. In class: Renk çemberinde yeşili bulun. (Find green on the color wheel.)

column1: 色に白をまぜて明るくしたもの。授業では Kırmızının açık tonunu elde etmek için beyaz ekleyin.(白をまぜて赤の明るい色を作ろう)
column2: A color mixed with white. In class: Kırmızının açık tonunu elde etmek için beyaz ekleyin. (Add white to make a tint of red.)

column1: 明暗や色の差を大きくして目立たせること。授業では Yüksek kontrast başlığın kolay okunmasını sağlar.(コントラストが強いと題名が読みやすい)
column2: A big difference in light or color. In class: Yüksek kontrast başlığın kolay okunmasını sağlar. (High contrast makes the title easy to read.)

column1: 画面の中での配置。授業では Resim yapmadan önce kompozisyonu düşünün.(描く前に構図を考えよう)
column2: How things are arranged in a picture. In class: Resim yapmadan önce kompozisyonu düşünün. (Think about the composition before you paint.)

column1: 中心の線をはさんで左右が同じ形であること。授業では Kelebeklerde simetri vardır.(チョウは左右対称だ)
column2: Both sides being the same. In class: Kelebeklerde simetri vardır. (Butterflies have symmetry.)

column1: ざらざら・つるつるなど表面の感じ。授業では Ağaç kabuğunun pürüzlü dokusunu gösterin.(木の皮のざらざらした質感を表そう)
column2: How a surface feels or looks. In class: Ağaç kabuğunun pürüzlü dokusunu gösterin. (Show the rough texture of the tree bark.)

column1: 形や色のくり返し。授業では Daireler ve çizgilerle bir desen oluşturun.(円と線で模様を作ろう)
column2: A repeated shape or color. In class: Daireler ve çizgilerle bir desen oluşturun. (Create a pattern with circles and lines.)

column1: 絵の手前の部分。授業では Büyük ağacı ön plana koyun.(大きな木を前景に置こう)
column2: The front part of a picture. In class: Büyük ağacı ön plana koyun. (Put the big tree in the foreground.)

column1: 絵の奥の部分。授業では Önce arka planı boyayın.(背景を先に塗ろう)
column2: The back part of a picture. In class: Önce arka planı boyayın. (Paint the background first.)

column1: 見る人の目がいちばん集まるところ。授業では Kırmızı çiçek resmin odak noktasıdır.(赤い花がこの絵の見せ場だ)
column2: Where the eye goes first. In class: Kırmızı çiçek resmin odak noktasıdır. (The red flower is the focal point of the painting.)

column1: 形のまわりの何もない部分。授業では Şekli öne çıkarmak için negatif alanı kullanın.(余白を生かして形を目立たせよう)
column2: The empty space around a shape. In class: Şekli öne çıkarmak için negatif alanı kullanın. (Use negative space to make the shape stand out.)

column1: 水でといて使う、すき通る絵の具。授業では Suluboya çabuk kurur, o yüzden hızlı çalışın.(水彩絵の具はすぐ乾くので手早く描こう)
column2: Clear paint you mix with water. In class: Suluboya çabuk kurur, o yüzden hızlı çalışın. (Watercolor dries quickly, so work fast.)

column1: 乾くと水に強くなる絵の具。授業では Akrilik boya kuruyunca su geçirmez olur.(アクリル絵の具は乾くと水をはじく)
column2: Paint that becomes waterproof when dry. In class: Akrilik boya kuruyunca su geçirmez olur. (Acrylic paint is waterproof when it dries.)

column1: 油絵などを描く布。授業では Tuvali çerçeveye gerin.(キャンバスを枠に張ろう)
column2: Cloth for painting on. In class: Tuvali çerçeveye gerin. (Stretch the canvas over the frame.)

column1: 絵を立てて置く台。授業では Altlığınızı şövaleye yerleştirin.(画板をイーゼルに立てよう)
column2: A stand that holds a picture. In class: Altlığınızı şövaleye yerleştirin. (Set your board on the easel.)

column1: 絵の具をまぜる板。授業では Renkleri kâğıtta değil, palette karıştırın.(色は紙の上ではなくパレットでまぜよう)
column2: The board you mix paint on. In class: Renkleri kâğıtta değil, palette karıştırın. (Mix the colors on your palette, not on the paper.)

column1: 黒く太い線が描ける画材。授業では Kömür kalem koyu gölgeler için harikadır.(木炭は濃い影にぴったりだ)
column2: A black stick for drawing dark lines. In class: Kömür kalem koyu gölgeler için harikadır. (Charcoal is great for dark shadows.)

column1: 形を自由に作れるやわらかい土。授業では Kilden küçük bir kâse yapın.(粘土で小さなお皿の形を作ろう)
column2: Soft earth you can shape. In class: Kilden küçük bir kâse yapın. (Shape the clay into a small bowl.)

column1: 紙や写真などをはり合わせて作る作品。授業では Eski dergilerden bir kolaj yapın.(古い雑誌でコラージュを作ろう)
column2: A picture made by gluing paper and photos. In class: Eski dergilerden bir kolaj yapın. (Make a collage from old magazines.)

column1: 色と色の境目をなめらかにする。授業では İki rengi ıslak bir fırçayla harmanlayın.(ぬれた筆で2つの色をぼかそう)
column2: To mix colors smoothly. In class: İki rengi ıslak bir fırçayla harmanlayın. (Blend the two colors with a wet brush.)

column1: 版を作ってインクで紙に写す方法。授業では Baskı resimle bir resmin birçok kopyasını yapabilirsiniz.(版画では1つの絵からたくさん刷ることができる)
column2: Making pictures by printing from a block. In class: Baskı resimle bir resmin birçok kopyasını yapabilirsiniz. (In printmaking, you can make many copies of one picture.)

column1: 刃物でけずって形を作る。授業では Kendinizi korumak için elinizden uzağa doğru oyun.(安全のため、手と反対の方向に彫ろう)
column2: To cut a shape out of a material. In class: Kendinizi korumak için elinizden uzağa doğru oyun. (Carve away from your hand to stay safe.)

column1: 立体的に作った作品。授業では Bu heykel taştan yapılmıştır.(この彫刻は石でできている)
column2: A work of art made in 3D. In class: Bu heykel taştan yapılmıştır. (This sculpture is made of stone.)

column1: 粘土を焼いて器などを作ること。授業では Seramik dersinde fırını kullanacağız.(陶芸の授業で窯を使う)
column2: Making things from clay and firing them. In class: Seramik dersinde fırını kullanacağız. (We'll use the kiln in ceramics class.)

column1: 回しながら粘土の形を作る台。授業では Çömlekçi çarkında ellerinizi ıslak tutun.(ろくろでは手をぬらしておこう)
column2: A spinning wheel for shaping clay. In class: Çömlekçi çarkında ellerinizi ıslak tutun. (Keep your hands wet on the pottery wheel.)

column1: 型紙の穴から色を塗って模様を写す方法。授業では Bir şablon kesin ve üzerinden sprey boya sıkın.(型紙を切りぬいて、上から色をふきつけよう)
column2: A cut-out shape you paint through. In class: Bir şablon kesin ve üzerinden sprey boya sıkın. (Cut out a stencil and spray paint through it.)

column1: 小さな石やガラスを並べて作る絵。授業では Zeminde minik karolardan yapılmış bir mozaik var.(床に小さなタイルで作ったモザイクがある)
column2: A picture made of small pieces of stone or glass. In class: Zeminde minik karolardan yapılmış bir mozaik var. (The floor has a mosaic made of tiny tiles.)

column1: 文字や絵を組み合わせて情報を伝えるデザイン。授業では Grafik tasarım afişlerde ve uygulamalarda kullanılır.(グラフィックデザインはポスターやアプリに使われる)
column2: Design that combines text and images to communicate. In class: Grafik tasarım afişlerde ve uygulamalarda kullanılır. (Graphic design is used in posters and apps.)

column1: 会社やチームを表すマーク。授業では Okul şenliğimiz için bir logo tasarlayın.(学校祭のロゴをデザインしよう)
column2: A mark that stands for a company or team. In class: Okul şenliğimiz için bir logo tasarlayın. (Design a logo for our school festival.)

column1: 文字のデザインの種類。授業では Kolay okunan bir yazı tipi seçin.(読みやすい書体を選ぼう)
column2: A style of letters. In class: Kolay okunan bir yazı tipi seçin. (Choose a font that is easy to read.)

column1: 文字や写真をどこに置くか。授業では Sayfa düzeni çok kalabalık görünüyor. Daha fazla boşluk bırakın.(レイアウトがつまって見える。もっと空間をとろう)
column2: Where the text and images go. In class: Sayfa düzeni çok kalabalık görünüyor. Daha fazla boşluk bırakın. (The layout looks crowded. Leave more space.)

column1: 文章を説明したり飾ったりする絵。授業では Afişinize bir illüstrasyon ekleyin.(ポスターにイラストを入れよう)
column2: A picture that explains or decorates a text. In class: Afişinize bir illüstrasyon ekleyin. (Add an illustration to your poster.)

column1: 映像やアニメの場面を順に描いた下絵。授業では Çekimden önce bir storyboard çizin.(撮影の前に絵コンテを描こう)
column2: Drawings of each scene of a film in order. In class: Çekimden önce bir storyboard çizin. (Draw a storyboard before filming.)

column1: 作品に使う色の組み合わせ。授業では Üç renkli bir renk düzeni seçin.(3色の配色を選ぼう)
column2: The set of colors used together. In class: Üç renkli bir renk düzeni seçin. (Pick a color scheme of three colors.)

column1: 考えを形にして試すための最初の作品。授業では Önce kartondan bir prototip yapın.(まず段ボールで試作品を作ろう)
column2: A first model to test an idea. In class: Önce kartondan bir prototip yapın. (Build a cardboard prototype first.)

column1: 光と色の移り変わりをとらえようとした19世紀の画家たち。授業では Monet, İzlenimciliğin öncülerinden biriydi.(モネは印象派の中心人物だった)
column2: 19th-century painting that caught light and color. In class: Monet, İzlenimciliğin öncülerinden biriydi. (Monet was a leader of Impressionism.)

column1: ものをいろいろな角度から見た形に分けて描いた動き。授業では Picasso Kübizmle ünlüdür.(ピカソはキュビスムで有名だ)
column2: Art that shows objects from many angles at once. In class: Picasso Kübizmle ünlüdür. (Picasso is famous for Cubism.)

column1: 形や色そのものを表現し、具体的なものを描かない美術。授業では Soyut sanat gerçek nesneleri göstermez.(抽象画は現実のものを描かない)
column2: Art that shows shapes and colors, not real things. In class: Soyut sanat gerçek nesneleri göstermez. (Abstract art doesn't show real objects.)

column1: 江戸時代の日本の版画。授業では Ukiyo-e birçok Avrupalı ressamı etkiledi.(浮世絵は多くのヨーロッパの画家に影響を与えた)
column2: Japanese woodblock prints of the Edo period. In class: Ukiyo-e birçok Avrupalı ressamı etkiledi. (Ukiyo-e influenced many European painters.)

column1: ぬれたしっくいの壁に描く絵。授業では Michelangelo şapelin tavanına freskler yaptı.(ミケランジェロは礼拝堂の天井にフレスコ画を描いた)
column2: Painting on wet plaster. In class: Michelangelo şapelin tavanına freskler yaptı. (Michelangelo painted frescoes on the chapel ceiling.)

column1: とてもすぐれた作品。授業では Mona Lisa ünlü bir başyapıttır.(モナ・リザは有名な傑作だ)
column2: A very great work of art. In class: Mona Lisa ünlü bir başyapıttır. (The Mona Lisa is a famous masterpiece.)

column1: 作品を並べて見せる催し。授業では Çalışmalarımız okul sergisinde olacak.(私たちの作品は学校の展覧会に出る)
column2: An event where works are shown. In class: Çalışmalarımız okul sergisinde olacak. (Our artwork will be in the school exhibition.)

column1: 美術作品を集めて展示する施設。授業では Gelecek cuma sanat müzesini ziyaret edeceğiz.(来週の金曜日に美術館へ行く)
column2: A place that shows works of art. In class: Gelecek cuma sanat müzesini ziyaret edeceğiz. (We'll visit the art museum next Friday.)

column1: 作品のよいところや改善点を話し合うこと。授業では Cuma günü sınıfça eser değerlendirmesi yapacağız.(金曜日にクラスで講評会をする)
column2: Talking about the strengths and weak points of a work. In class: Cuma günü sınıfça eser değerlendirmesi yapacağız. (We'll have a class critique on Friday.)

column1: 作品が何を表しているか自分なりに考える。授業では Bu resmi nasıl yorumluyorsunuz?(この絵をどう解釈する?)
column2: To decide what a work means to you. In class: Bu resmi nasıl yorumluyorsunuz? (How do you interpret this painting?)

column1: 作品から感じる気分。授業では Koyu renkler hüzünlü bir atmosfer yaratır.(暗い色が悲しい雰囲気を生んでいる)
column2: The feeling a work gives. In class: Koyu renkler hüzünlü bir atmosfer yaratır. (The dark colors create a sad mood.)

column1: ものに別の意味をもたせて表すこと。授業では Sembolizmde beyaz güvercin barışı temsil eder.(白いハトは平和の象徴だ)
column2: Using things to stand for ideas. In class: Sembolizmde beyaz güvercin barışı temsil eder. (The white dove is symbolism for peace.)

column1: 作品に使った材料や方法。授業では Sanatçı hangi malzemeyi kullandı?(その画家はどんな画材を使ったかな?)
column2: The material an artist uses. In class: Sanatçı hangi malzemeyi kullandı? (What medium did the artist use?)

column1: 自分自身を描いた絵。授業では Van Gogh birçok otoportre yaptı.(ゴッホはたくさんの自画像を描いた)
column2: A picture of the artist by the artist. In class: Van Gogh birçok otoportre yaptı. (Van Gogh painted many self-portraits.)

column1: 作者が作品について説明する短い文章。授業では Eseriniz için kısa bir sanatçı açıklaması yazın.(自分の作品に短い作品解説を書こう)
column2: A short text in which artists explain their work. In class: Eseriniz için kısa bir sanatçı açıklaması yazın. (Write a short artist statement for your work.)

column1: 相手が次によくなるための前向きな意見。授業では Arkadaşınıza yapıcı eleştiri yapın.(ペアの相手に建設的な意見を伝えよう)
column2: Helpful comments that help someone improve. In class: Arkadaşınıza yapıcı eleştiri yapın. (Give your partner constructive feedback.)

column1: 0より大きい数。授業では Bilangan positif lebih besar dari nol.(正の数は0より大きい)
column2: A number greater than zero. In class: Bilangan positif lebih besar dari nol. (Positive numbers are greater than zero.)

column1: 0より小さい数。授業では Minus lima adalah bilangan negatif.(-5は負の数です)
column2: A number less than zero. In class: Minus lima adalah bilangan negatif. (Minus five is a negative number.)

column1: 0からの距離。授業では Nilai mutlak dari minus tiga adalah tiga.(-3の絶対値は3)
column2: The distance of a number from zero. In class: Nilai mutlak dari minus tiga adalah tiga. (The absolute value of minus three is three.)

column1: …,-1, 0, 1, 2,… のような数。授業では Apakah nol koma lima bilangan bulat?(0.5は整数かな?)
column2: A whole number such as -1, 0 or 2. In class: Apakah nol koma lima bilangan bulat? (Is zero point five an integer?)

column1: 分数の上の数。授業では Pada dua pertiga, pembilangnya adalah dua.(2/3の分子は2)
column2: The number above the line in a fraction. In class: Pada dua pertiga, pembilangnya adalah dua. (In two thirds, the numerator is two.)

column1: 分数の下の数。授業では Samakan penyebutnya.(分母をそろえよう=通分)
column2: The number below the line in a fraction. In class: Samakan penyebutnya. (Find the common denominator.)

column1: 0.5 のような数。授業では Tulis seperempat sebagai bilangan desimal.(1/4を小数で書こう)
column2: A number like 0.5. In class: Tulis seperempat sebagai bilangan desimal. (Write one quarter as a decimal.)

column1: かけて1になる数。授業では Kebalikan dari tiga adalah sepertiga.(3の逆数は1/3)
column2: The number you multiply by to get 1. In class: Kebalikan dari tiga adalah sepertiga. (The reciprocal of three is one third.)

column1: 2乗するとその数になる数。授業では Akar kuadrat dari sembilan adalah tiga.(9の平方根は3)
column2: The number that, multiplied by itself, gives the number. In class: Akar kuadrat dari sembilan adalah tiga. (The square root of nine is three.)

column1: 数や文字を記号でつないだもの。授業では Sederhanakan bentuk aljabar ini.(式を簡単にしよう)
column2: Numbers and letters joined by signs. In class: Sederhanakan bentuk aljabar ini. (Simplify the expression.)

column1: x や y のように、いろいろな値をとる文字。授業では Di sini, x adalah variabel.(ここでは x が変数)
column2: A letter that stands for a number. In class: Di sini, x adalah variabel. (Here, x is a variable.)

column1: 文字にかかっている数。授業では Pada lima x, koefisiennya adalah lima.(5xの係数は5)
column2: The number in front of a letter. In class: Pada lima x, koefisiennya adalah lima. (In five x, the coefficient is five.)

column1: 方程式から x の値を求めること。授業では Cari nilai x, lalu periksa jawabanmu.(xを求めて、答えを確かめよう)
column2: To find the value of x in an equation. In class: Cari nilai x, lalu periksa jawabanmu. (Solve for x and check your answer.)

column1: かっこをはずして式を広げること。授業では Jabarkan tanda kurungnya.(かっこを展開しよう)
column2: To remove the brackets and multiply out. In class: Jabarkan tanda kurungnya. (Expand the brackets.)

column1: 式をかけ算の形にすること。イギリスでは factorise とも。授業では Faktorkan x kuadrat dikurangi empat.(x²-4を因数分解しよう)

column2: The same shape but a different size. In class: Bangun-bangun yang sebangun mempunyai bentuk yang sama. (Similar figures have the same shape.)

column2: To show that something is true, with reasons. In class: Buktikan bahwa sudut A sama dengan sudut B. (Prove that angle A equals angle B.)

column2: A² + b² = c² in a right triangle. In class: Gunakan teorema Pythagoras untuk mencari panjangnya. (Use the Pythagorean theorem to find the length.)

column2: How steep a line is. In class: Gradien garis ini adalah dua. (The slope of this line is two.)

column2: How likely something is to happen. In class: Berapa peluang muncul gambar? (What is the probability of getting heads?)

column2: One possible result. In class: Tuliskan semua hasil yang mungkin. (List all the possible outcomes.)

column2: The middle value when the data are in order. In class: Tentukan mediannya. (Find the median.)

column2: The part of a cell that carries traits from parents. In class: Gen diturunkan dari orang tua ke anak. (Genes are passed from parents to children.)

column1: 生物が長い年月をかけて変化すること。授業では Fosil memberikan bukti adanya evolusi.(化石は進化の証拠になる)
column2: How living things change over a very long time. In class: Fosil memberikan bukti adanya evolusi. (Fossils give evidence of evolution.)

column1: 細胞分裂のときに見える、遺伝子をのせたもの。授業では Kromosom dapat terlihat saat pembelahan sel.(染色体は細胞分裂のときに見える)
column2: A thread in a cell that carries genes. In class: Kromosom dapat terlihat saat pembelahan sel. (Chromosomes can be seen during cell division.)

column1: 1つの細胞が2つに分かれること。授業では Amati pembelahan sel pada ujung akar bawang.(タマネギの根で細胞分裂を観察しよう)
column2: One cell splitting into two. In class: Amati pembelahan sel pada ujung akar bawang. (Observe cell division in an onion root.)

column1: 卵と精子(や精細胞)が合体すること。授業では Pembuahan menghasilkan sel baru.(受精で新しい細胞ができる)
column2: An egg and a sperm (or sperm cell) joining. In class: Pembuahan menghasilkan sel baru. (Fertilization produces a new cell.)

column1: 親の特徴が子に伝わること。授業では Mendel meneliti pewarisan sifat dengan kacang ercis.(メンデルはエンドウで遺伝を研究した)
column2: Passing traits from parents to children. In class: Mendel meneliti pewarisan sifat dengan kacang ercis. (Mendel studied heredity using peas.)

column1: 「食べる・食べられる」のつながり。授業では Gambarlah rantai makanan di hutan.(森の食物連鎖をかこう)
column2: The line of who eats whom in nature. In class: Gambarlah rantai makanan di hutan. (Draw a food chain for the forest.)

column1: 光合成で栄養分をつくる生物(植物など)。授業では Tumbuhan adalah produsen.(植物は生産者)
column2: A living thing that makes its own food (like a plant). In class: Tumbuhan adalah produsen. (Plants are producers.)

column1: ほかの生物を食べて栄養分をとる生物。授業では Hewan adalah konsumen.(動物は消費者)
column2: A living thing that eats other living things. In class: Hewan adalah konsumen. (Animals are consumers.)

column1: 死がいやふんを分解する生物(菌類など)。授業では Jamur adalah pengurai.(菌類は分解者)
column2: A living thing that breaks down dead matter. In class: Jamur adalah pengurai. (Fungi are decomposers.)

column1: 大地がゆれること。授業では Gempa bumi itu terasa di seluruh wilayah.(その地震は地域全体で感じられた)
column2: A shaking of the ground. In class: Gempa bumi itu terasa di seluruh wilayah. (The earthquake was felt across the region.)

column1: 震源の真上の地表の点。イギリスでは epicentre。授業では Tandai episentrumnya di peta.(地図に震央をかこう)
column2: The point on the surface right above where an earthquake starts. In class: Tandai episentrumnya di peta. (Mark the epicenter on the map.)

column1: マグマがふき出してできた山。授業では Gunung berapi ini masih aktif.(この火山は今も活動している)
column2: A mountain where magma comes out. In class: Gunung berapi ini masih aktif. (This volcano is still active.)

column1: 地下でとけている岩石。授業では Magma mendingin dan membentuk batuan beku.(マグマが冷えて火成岩になる)
column2: Melted rock under the ground. In class: Magma mendingin dan membentuk batuan beku. (Magma cools to form igneous rock.)

column1: 大昔の生物の死がいや跡が残ったもの。授業では Fosil menceritakan kehidupan zaman purba.(化石から大昔の生物がわかる)
column2: What is left of a living thing from long ago, turned to rock. In class: Fosil menceritakan kehidupan zaman purba. (Fossils tell us about ancient life.)

column1: 積み重なった層。地層は rock layers や strata とも。授業では Lapisan yang lebih bawah biasanya lebih tua.(ふつう下の層ほど古い)
column2: One level of rock or soil. In class: Lapisan yang lebih bawah biasanya lebih tua. (The lower layers are usually older.)

column1: 水や風が岩や土をけずること。授業では Sungai menyebabkan erosi.(川は侵食を起こす)
column2: Water or wind wearing away rock and soil. In class: Sungai menyebabkan erosi. (Rivers cause erosion.)

column1: 土砂などが積もって固まった岩石。授業では Batu pasir adalah batuan sedimen.(砂岩は堆積岩)
column2: Rock formed from layers of sand and mud. In class: Batu pasir adalah batuan sedimen. (Sandstone is a sedimentary rock.)

column1: 空気がおす力。授業では Tekanan udara turun, jadi mungkin akan hujan.(気圧が下がっているので雨かも)
column2: The push of the air. In class: Tekanan udara turun, jadi mungkin akan hujan. (Air pressure is falling, so it may rain.)

column1: 性質のちがう空気の境目。cold front は寒冷前線。授業では Front dingin sedang mendekat.(寒冷前線が近づいている)
column2: The boundary between two different air masses. In class: Front dingin sedang mendekat. (A cold front is coming.)

column1: 空気中の水蒸気の割合。授業では Kelembapan hari ini tinggi.(今日は湿度が高い)
column2: How much water vapor is in the air. In class: Kelembapan hari ini tinggi. (The humidity is high today.)

column1: 水蒸気が冷えて水滴になること。授業では Kondensasi membentuk awan.(凝結で雲ができる)
column2: Water vapor cooling into drops. In class: Kondensasi membentuk awan. (Condensation forms clouds.)

column1: 天体が自分の軸のまわりを回ること。授業では Rotasi bumi menyebabkan siang dan malam.(地球の自転で昼と夜ができる)
column2: Spinning on its own axis. In class: Rotasi bumi menyebabkan siang dan malam. (The Earth's rotation causes day and night.)

column1: 天体がほかの天体のまわりを回ること。授業では Revolusi bumi memerlukan waktu sekitar satu tahun.(地球の公転には約1年かかる)
column2: Going around another body. In class: Revolusi bumi memerlukan waktu sekitar satu tahun. (The Earth's revolution takes about a year.)

column1: 太陽とそのまわりを回る天体の集まり。授業では Ada delapan planet di tata surya.(太陽系には8つの惑星がある)
column2: The Sun and everything that goes around it. In class: Ada delapan planet di tata surya. (There are eight planets in the solar system.)

column1: solar eclipse は日食、lunar eclipse は月食。授業では Gerhana matahari terjadi ketika bulan menutupi matahari.(月が太陽をかくすと日食が起こる)
column2: When one body hides another (solar or lunar). In class: Gerhana matahari terjadi ketika bulan menutupi matahari. (A solar eclipse happens when the Moon blocks the Sun.)

column1: 赤道から北や南へどれだけ離れているか。授業では Tokyo terletak di sekitar 36 derajat lintang utara.(東京は北緯約36度にある)
column2: How far north or south of the equator. In class: Tokyo terletak di sekitar 36 derajat lintang utara. (Tokyo is at about 36 degrees north latitude.)

column1: イギリスのグリニッジから東や西へどれだけ離れているか。授業では Garis bujur membentang dari Kutub Utara ke Kutub Selatan.(経線は北極から南極へのびている)
column2: How far east or west of Greenwich. In class: Garis bujur membentang dari Kutub Utara ke Kutub Selatan. (Lines of longitude run from the North Pole to the South Pole.)

column1: 地球を半分に分けた片方。授業では Australia terletak di belahan bumi selatan.(オーストラリアは南半球にある)
column2: One half of the Earth. In class: Australia terletak di belahan bumi selatan. (Australia is in the Southern Hemisphere.)

column1: 同じ時刻を使う地域。授業では Jepang dan Korea berada di zona waktu yang sama.(日本と韓国は同じ時間帯にある)
column2: An area that uses the same time. In class: Jepang dan Korea berada di zona waktu yang sama. (Japan and Korea are in the same time zone.)

column1: 三方を海に囲まれた陸地。授業では Italia adalah semenanjung panjang berbentuk sepatu bot.(イタリアはブーツの形をした長い半島だ)
column2: Land with the sea on three sides. In class: Italia adalah semenanjung panjang berbentuk sepatu bot. (Italy is a long peninsula shaped like a boot.)

column1: 高いところに広がる平らな土地。授業では Sebagian besar Meksiko terletak di dataran tinggi.(メキシコの多くは高い高原の上にある)
column2: High flat land. In class: Sebagian besar Meksiko terletak di dataran tinggi. (Much of Mexico sits on a high plateau.)

column1: まわりを山に囲まれた低い土地。授業では Kyoto terletak di cekungan, jadi musim panasnya sangat panas.(京都は盆地にあるので夏はとても暑い)
column2: Low land surrounded by mountains. In class: Kyoto terletak di cekungan, jadi musim panasnya sangat panas. (Kyoto is in a basin, so summers are very hot.)

column1: 川の河口に土砂がたまってできた平地。授業では Delta Sungai Nil sangat baik untuk pertanian.(ナイル川の三角州は農業にとても向いている)
column2: Flat land at the mouth of a river. In class: Delta Sungai Nil sangat baik untuk pertanian. (The Nile Delta is very good for farming.)

column1: 一定の面積に何人住んでいるか。授業では Kepadatan penduduk Tokyo sangat tinggi.(東京は人口密度がとても高い)
column2: How many people live in a given area. In class: Kepadatan penduduk Tokyo sangat tinggi. (Tokyo has a very high population density.)

column1: 人が都市に集まり、町が都市になっていくこと。授業では Urbanisasi membawa orang dari desa ke kota-kota besar.(都市化によって人が農村から大都市へ移る)
column2: People moving to cities and towns growing into cities. In class: Urbanisasi membawa orang dari desa ke kota-kota besar. (Urbanization brings people from farms to big cities.)

column1: 石油・石炭・木材など、自然からとれる役に立つもの。授業では Jepang memiliki sedikit sumber daya alam, jadi Jepang mengimpor minyak.(日本は天然資源が少ないので石油を輸入している)
column2: Useful things from nature, like oil and wood. In class: Jepang memiliki sedikit sumber daya alam, jadi Jepang mengimpor minyak. (Japan has few natural resources, so it imports oil.)

column1: 国内のものを外国に売ること。授業では Jepang mengekspor banyak mobil.(日本はたくさんの車を輸出している)
column2: To sell goods to other countries. In class: Jepang mengekspor banyak mobil. (Japan exports a lot of cars.)

column1: 外国のものを国内に買い入れること。授業では Sebagian besar gandum di Jepang diimpor.(日本の小麦のほとんどは輸入されている)
column2: To buy goods from other countries. In class: Sebagian besar gandum di Jepang diimpor. (Most of the wheat in Japan is imported.)

column1: 作物を育てたり家畜を飼ったりする仕事。授業では Pertanian penting di daerah ini.(この地域では農業が大切だ)
column2: Growing crops and raising animals. In class: Pertanian penting di daerah ini. (Agriculture is important in this region.)

column1: 工場でものを作る産業。授業では Industri manufaktur tumbuh pesat setelah perang.(戦後、製造業は急速に成長した)
column2: Making goods in factories. In class: Industri manufaktur tumbuh pesat setelah perang. (Manufacturing grew quickly after the war.)

column1: 旅行者を受け入れる産業。授業では Pariwisata adalah bagian penting dari ekonomi Hawaii.(観光業はハワイの経済の大きな部分をしめている)
column2: The business of travelers and visitors. In class: Pariwisata adalah bagian penting dari ekonomi Hawaii. (Tourism is a big part of Hawaii's economy.)

column1: 文字の記録が残る前の時代の。授業では Manusia prasejarah melukis hewan di dinding gua.(先史時代の人々は洞窟の壁に動物を描いた)
column2: From the time before written records. In class: Manusia prasejarah melukis hewan di dinding gua. (Prehistoric people painted animals on cave walls.)

column1: 都市・文字・国のしくみが発達した社会。授業では Empat peradaban besar lahir di tepi sungai besar.(四大文明は大きな川のほとりで始まった)
column2: A society with cities, writing and government. In class: Empat peradaban besar lahir di tepi sungai besar. (Four great civilizations began along big rivers.)

column1: 皇帝などが広い地域や多くの民族を支配する国。授業では Kekaisaran Romawi bertahan ratusan tahun.(ローマ帝国は何百年も続いた)
column2: A state where one ruler governs many lands and peoples. In class: Kekaisaran Romawi bertahan ratusan tahun. (The Roman Empire lasted for hundreds of years.)

column1: 同じ家系の人が代々治めた時代。授業では Dinasti Tang berdagang dengan Jepang.(唐の王朝は日本と交流した)
column2: A family that rules for many generations. In class: Dinasti Tang berdagang dengan Jepang. (The Tang Dynasty traded with Japan.)

column1: ヨーロッパでは5世紀ごろから15世紀ごろまで。授業では Kesatria dan kastel adalah simbol Abad Pertengahan.(騎士と城は中世の象徴だ)
column2: In Europe, about the 5th to the 15th century. In class: Kesatria dan kastel adalah simbol Abad Pertengahan. (Knights and castles are symbols of the Middle Ages.)

column1: 主君が土地を与え、家臣が仕えるしくみ。授業では Dalam feodalisme, para tuan tanah memberikan tanah kepada vasal mereka.(封建制度では、領主が家臣に土地を与えた)
column2: A system where lords give land and vassals serve them. In class: Dalam feodalisme, para tuan tanah memberikan tanah kepada vasal mereka. (Under feudalism, lords gave land to their vassals.)

column1: 14〜16世紀のヨーロッパで、芸術や学問が生まれ変わった動き。授業では Leonardo da Vinci adalah seniman zaman Renaisans.(レオナルド・ダ・ヴィンチはルネサンスの芸術家だ)
column2: The rebirth of art and learning in Europe, 14th–16th century. In class: Leonardo da Vinci adalah seniman zaman Renaisans. (Leonardo da Vinci was a Renaissance artist.)

column1: ほかの国に支配された土地。授業では India pernah menjadi jajahan Inggris.(インドはかつてイギリスの植民地だった)
column2: A land ruled by another country. In class: India pernah menjadi jajahan Inggris. (India was once a British colony.)

column1: 18世紀のイギリスで始まった、機械による生産の大変化。授業では Mesin uap mengubah segalanya pada masa Revolusi Industri.(産業革命では蒸気機関がすべてを変えた)
column2: The change to machine production that began in 18th-century Britain. In class: Mesin uap mengubah segalanya pada masa Revolusi Industri. (The steam engine changed everything in the Industrial Revolution.)

column1: ほかの国の支配から離れて自分の国になること。授業では Amerika Serikat menyatakan kemerdekaan pada tahun 1776.(アメリカは1776年に独立を宣言した)
column2: Becoming a country free from another country's rule. In class: Amerika Serikat menyatakan kemerdekaan pada tahun 1776. (The United States declared independence in 1776.)

column1: 国と国が文書で結ぶ約束。授業では Kedua negara menandatangani perjanjian damai.(2つの国は平和条約に署名した)
column2: A written agreement between countries. In class: Kedua negara menandatangani perjanjian damai. (The two countries signed a peace treaty.)

column1: 1939年から1945年まで続いた世界規模の戦争。授業では Perang Dunia II berakhir pada tahun 1945.(第二次世界大戦は1945年に終わった)
column2: The world war from 1939 to 1945. In class: Perang Dunia II berakhir pada tahun 1945. (World War II ended in 1945.)

column1: アメリカとソ連が直接は戦わずに対立した時代。授業では Tembok Berlin adalah simbol Perang Dingin.(ベルリンの壁は冷戦の象徴だった)
column2: The long standoff between the USA and the USSR. In class: Tembok Berlin adalah simbol Perang Dingin. (The Berlin Wall was a symbol of the Cold War.)

column1: 人種などで差別されずに平等に扱われる権利。授業では Martin Luther King memperjuangkan hak-hak sipil.(キング牧師は公民権のために闘った)
column2: The right to be treated equally. In class: Martin Luther King memperjuangkan hak-hak sipil. (Martin Luther King Jr. fought for civil rights.)

column1: その時代の人が直接残した手紙や日記などの資料。授業では Buku harian ini adalah sumber primer dari masa perang.(この日記は戦争のときの一次資料だ)
column2: A letter, diary or record from the time itself. In class: Buku harian ini adalah sumber primer dari masa perang. (This diary is a primary source from the war.)

column1: できごとを起きた順に並べた表。授業では Letakkan peristiwa-peristiwa ini pada garis waktu.(これらのできごとを年表に並べよう)
column2: Events listed in the order they happened. In class: Letakkan peristiwa-peristiwa ini pada garis waktu. (Put these events on the timeline.)

column1: 国民が選挙などを通して政治を決めるしくみ。授業では Dalam demokrasi, rakyat memilih pemimpinnya.(民主主義では、国民がリーダーを選ぶ)
column2: Government chosen by the people. In class: Dalam demokrasi, rakyat memilih pemimpinnya. (In a democracy, people choose their leaders.)

column1: 法律を作る、選ばれた代表の集まり。授業では Parlemen Inggris bersidang di London.(イギリスの議会はロンドンで開かれる)
column2: The elected group that makes the laws. In class: Parlemen Inggris bersidang di London. (The British Parliament meets in London.)

column1: 議会で選ばれる政府のリーダー。授業では Perdana menteri memimpin kabinet.(首相は内閣を率いる)
column2: The leader of the government chosen by parliament. In class: Perdana menteri memimpin kabinet. (The prime minister leads the cabinet.)

column1: 国民の選挙などで選ばれる国のリーダー。授業では Presiden Amerika Serikat menjabat selama empat tahun.(アメリカの大統領の任期は4年だ)
column2: The elected leader of a country. In class: Presiden Amerika Serikat menjabat selama empat tahun. (The president of the United States serves a four-year term.)

column1: 同じ考えの人が集まって政治を行う団体。授業では Setiap partai politik memiliki gagasannya sendiri.(政党にはそれぞれの考えがある)
column2: A group of people with the same political ideas. In class: Setiap partai politik memiliki gagasannya sendiri. (Each political party has its own ideas.)

column1: 選挙などで自分の意見を示すこと。授業では Di Jepang, kamu bisa memberikan suara pada usia delapan belas tahun.(日本では18歳で投票できる)
column2: To choose in an election. In class: Di Jepang, kamu bisa memberikan suara pada usia delapan belas tahun. (In Japan, you can vote at eighteen.)

column1: 全体の半分より多い数。授業では Rancangan undang-undang itu disahkan dengan suara terbanyak.(その法案は過半数の票で可決された)
column2: More than half. In class: Rancangan undang-undang itu disahkan dengan suara terbanyak. (The bill passed with a majority of votes.)

column1: その国や町の一員として権利と義務をもつ人。授業では Setiap warga negara berhak berbicara dengan bebas.(すべての市民は自由に意見を言う権利がある)
column2: A member of a country with rights and duties. In class: Setiap warga negara berhak berbicara dengan bebas. (Every citizen has the right to speak freely.)

column1: 人が生まれながらにもつ権利。授業では Hak asasi manusia setiap orang harus dihormati.(すべての人の人権が尊重されなければならない)
column2: The rights every person is born with. In class: Hak asasi manusia setiap orang harus dihormati. (Everyone's human rights must be respected.)

column1: 立法・行政・司法を分けて、権力が集まりすぎないようにするしくみ。授業では Pemisahan kekuasaan melindungi kita dari penyalahgunaan kekuasaan.(三権分立は権力の乱用から私たちを守る)
column2: Dividing power among the lawmakers, the government and the courts. In class: Pemisahan kekuasaan melindungi kita dari penyalahgunaan kekuasaan. (The separation of powers protects us from abuse of power.)

column1: 法律を作る仕事(議会)。授業では Lembaga legislatif membuat undang-undang.(立法府は法律を作る)
column2: The part that makes the laws. In class: Lembaga legislatif membuat undang-undang. (The legislative branch makes the laws.)

column1: 法律にもとづいて国の仕事を行う(内閣・政府)。授業では Lembaga eksekutif menjalankan undang-undang.(行政府は法律を実行する)
column2: The part that carries out the laws. In class: Lembaga eksekutif menjalankan undang-undang. (The executive branch carries out the laws.)

column1: 裁判によって争いを解決する(裁判所)。授業では Lembaga yudikatif memutuskan apakah suatu undang-undang adil.(司法府は法律が公正かどうかを判断する)
column2: The courts, which judge by the law. In class: Lembaga yudikatif memutuskan apakah suatu undang-undang adil. (The judicial branch decides if a law is fair.)

column1: 都道府県や市町村など、地域の政治を行うところ。授業では Pemerintah daerah mengelola sekolah dan taman.(地方自治体は学校や公園を運営する)
column2: The government of a city, town or region. In class: Pemerintah daerah mengelola sekolah dan taman. (Local governments run schools and parks.)

column1: 世界の平和と協力のための国際組織。授業では Perserikatan Bangsa-Bangsa memiliki 193 negara anggota.(国際連合には193の加盟国がある)
column2: The international organization for peace and cooperation. In class: Perserikatan Bangsa-Bangsa memiliki 193 negara anggota. (The United Nations has 193 member states.)

column1: 考えを自由に話したり書いたりできる権利。授業では Kebebasan berpendapat dilindungi oleh konstitusi.(表現の自由は憲法で守られている)
column2: The right to say and write what you think. In class: Kebebasan berpendapat dilindungi oleh konstitusi. (Freedom of speech is protected by the constitution.)

column1: 売るために市場に出されるものの量。授業では Ketika penawaran naik, harga biasanya turun.(供給が増えると、ふつう価格は下がる)
column2: The amount of goods for sale. In class: Ketika penawaran naik, harga biasanya turun. (When supply goes up, prices usually go down.)

column1: 買いたいと思われているものの量。授業では Permintaan akan ponsel pintar baru sangat tinggi.(新しいスマートフォンの需要は高い)
column2: The amount of goods people want to buy. In class: Permintaan akan ponsel pintar baru sangat tinggi. (There is a high demand for new smartphones.)

column1: 需要と供給で決まる、ものの値段。授業では Harga pasar beras berubah setiap tahun.(米の市場価格は毎年変わる)
column2: The price set by supply and demand. In class: Harga pasar beras berubah setiap tahun. (The market price of rice changes every year.)

column1: 会社どうしが客をめぐって競い合うこと。授業では Persaingan antarperusahaan membuat harga tetap rendah.(会社どうしの競争で価格が低く保たれる)
column2: Companies trying to win customers. In class: Persaingan antarperusahaan membuat harga tetap rendah. (Competition between companies keeps prices low.)

column1: 売り上げから費用を引いた残り。授業では Perusahaan itu mendapat keuntungan besar tahun ini.(その会社は今年大きな利益を出した)
column2: The money left after costs. In class: Perusahaan itu mendapat keuntungan besar tahun ini. (The company made a big profit this year.)

column1: お金を集めて事業を行う会社。授業では Toyota adalah salah satu perusahaan terbesar di Jepang.(トヨタは日本で最も大きな企業の一つだ)
column2: A large company. In class: Toyota adalah salah satu perusahaan terbesar di Jepang. (Toyota is one of the largest corporations in Japan.)

column1: 会社がお金を集めるために発行する、会社の持ち分。授業では Orang membeli saham perusahaan yang mereka percayai.(人々は信頼する会社の株式を買う)
column2: A share of a company. In class: Orang membeli saham perusahaan yang mereka percayai. (People buy stock in companies they believe in.)

column1: 国や自治体の仕事のために国民が納めるお金。授業では Pajak dipakai untuk membangun jalan dan sekolah.(税金で道路や学校がまかなわれている)
column2: Money people pay for public services. In class: Pajak dipakai untuk membangun jalan dan sekolah. (Taxes pay for roads and schools.)

column1: 物価が上がり続け、お金の価値が下がること。授業では Karena inflasi, harga roti lebih mahal daripada tahun lalu.(インフレのせいで、パンは去年より高い)
column2: Prices rising and money losing value. In class: Karena inflasi, harga roti lebih mahal daripada tahun lalu. (Because of inflation, bread costs more than last year.)

column1: 物価が下がり続けること。授業では Jepang pernah lama mengalami deflasi.(日本は長いデフレの時期があった)
column2: Prices falling. In class: Jepang pernah lama mengalami deflasi. (Japan had a long period of deflation.)

column1: お金を借りたり預けたりしたときにつく利子の割合。授業では Bank itu menaikkan suku bunganya.(銀行は金利を上げた)
column2: The percentage paid for borrowing or saving money. In class: Bank itu menaikkan suku bunganya. (The bank raised its interest rate.)

column1: ある国のお金を別の国のお金に替えるときの割合。授業では Nilai tukarnya 150 yen per dolar.(為替レートは1ドル150円だ)
column2: The price of one currency in another. In class: Nilai tukarnya 150 yen per dolar. (The exchange rate is 150 yen to the dollar.)

column1: 使うお金の計画。授業では Pemerintah menyusun anggaran untuk tahun depan.(政府は来年の予算を作った)
column2: A plan for spending money. In class: Pemerintah menyusun anggaran untuk tahun depan. (The government made a budget for next year.)

column1: 国と国の間でものを売り買いすること。授業では Perdagangan antara Jepang dan Tiongkok sangat aktif.(日本と中国の貿易はとてもさかんだ)
column2: Buying and selling between countries. In class: Perdagangan antara Jepang dan Tiongkok sangat aktif. (Trade between Japan and China is very active.)

column1: 輸入品にかける税金。授業では Tarif bea masuk membuat barang impor lebih mahal.(関税をかけると輸入品が高くなる)
column2: A tax on imported goods. In class: Tarif bea masuk membuat barang impor lebih mahal. (A tariff makes imported goods more expensive.)

column1: 人・もの・お金・情報が国境をこえて世界中に広がること。授業では Globalisasi menghubungkan ekonomi di seluruh dunia.(グローバル化は世界中の経済をつなぐ)
column2: People, goods, money and information crossing borders worldwide. In class: Globalisasi menghubungkan ekonomi di seluruh dunia. (Globalization connects economies around the world.)

column1: 名詞の代わりに使う語(「彼」「それ」など)。授業では Ganti kata benda itu dengan kata ganti.(名詞を代名詞に置き換えよう)
column2: A word used instead of a noun. In class: Ganti kata benda itu dengan kata ganti. (Replace the noun with a pronoun.)

column1: 動詞や形容詞などをくわしくする語。授業では “Segera” adalah kata keterangan.(「スグラ(すぐに)」は副詞です)
column2: A word that tells more about a verb or an adjective. In class: “Segera” adalah kata keterangan. ("Segera" (immediately) is an adverb.)

column1: 名詞の前に置いて、場所や時などを表す語。授業では Gunakan kata depan “di” untuk menyatakan tempat.(場所を言うときは前置詞「ディ」を使おう)
column2: A word before a noun that shows place or time. In class: Gunakan kata depan “di” untuk menyatakan tempat. (Use the preposition "di" to talk about places.)

column1: 語や文をつなぐ語(「そして」「しかし」など)。授業では Gabungkan kedua kalimat dengan kata hubung.(接続詞で2つの文をつなごう)
column2: A word that joins words or sentences. In class: Gabungkan kedua kalimat dengan kata hubung. (Join the two sentences with a conjunction.)

column1: 接辞
column2: affix

column1: 語の前やあとについて意味や働きを変える部分。授業では Imbuhan “me-” dan “di-” mengubah arti kata kerja: “memukul” dan “dipukul”.(接辞「ム」と「ディ」で動詞の意味が変わります:「ムムクル(たたく)」と「ディプクル(たたかれる)」)
column2: A part added to the start or end of a word. In class: Imbuhan “me-” dan “di-” mengubah arti kata kerja: “memukul” dan “dipukul”. (The affixes "me-" and "di-" change the verb: "memukul" (to hit) and "dipukul" (to be hit).)

column1: 標準語(正しい言葉づかい)
column2: standard language

column1: 作文や公式の場で使う、正しいとされる言葉づかい。授業では Dalam karangan, gunakan bahasa baku: “tidak”, bukan “nggak”.(作文では標準語を使おう。「ンガッ」ではなく「ティダッ(〜ない)」です)
column2: The correct form of a language used in writing and formal situations. In class: Dalam karangan, gunakan bahasa baku: “tidak”, bukan “nggak”. (In essays, use standard Indonesian: "tidak" (not), not "nggak".)

column1: 2つ以上を表す形。授業では Bahasa Indonesia sering menyatakan bentuk jamak dengan kata seperti “banyak” atau “para”.(インドネシア語では「バニャッ(たくさんの)」や「パラ(〜たち)」のような言葉で複数を表すことが多いです)
column2: The form for more than one. In class: Bahasa Indonesia sering menyatakan bentuk jamak dengan kata seperti “banyak” atau “para”. (Indonesian often shows the plural with words like "banyak" (many) or "para".)

column1: 重複語(くり返しの語)
column2: reduplication

column1: 語をくり返して、複数などの意味を表す形。授業では “Buku-buku” adalah kata ulang yang berarti banyak buku.(「ブク ブク」は重複語で、「たくさんの本」という意味です)
column2: Repeating a word to show plural or another meaning. In class: “Buku-buku” adalah kata ulang yang berarti banyak buku. ("Buku-buku" is a reduplicated word meaning "many books".)

column1: 主語と動詞をふくむ、文の一部。授業では “Karena hujan turun” adalah anak kalimat, bukan kalimat lengkap.(「カルナ フジャン トゥルン(雨が降ったので)」は従属節で、完全な文ではありません)
column2: A group of words with a subject and a verb. In class: “Karena hujan turun” adalah anak kalimat, bukan kalimat lengkap. ("Karena hujan turun" (because it rained) is a clause, not a full sentence.)

column1: 主語と動詞のそろわない、語のまとまり。授業では “Pada pagi hari” adalah frasa.(「パダ パギ ハリ(朝に)」は句です)
column2: A group of words without both a subject and a verb. In class: “Pada pagi hari” adalah frasa. ("Pada pagi hari" (in the morning) is a phrase.)

column1: ピリオド・コンマ・クエスチョンマークなどの記号。授業では Jangan lupa tanda baca di akhir setiap kalimat.(それぞれの文の終わりの句読点を忘れないで)
column2: Marks such as periods, commas and question marks. In class: Jangan lupa tanda baca di akhir setiap kalimat. (Don't forget the punctuation at the end of each sentence.)

column1: 大文字の使い方
column2: capitalization

column1: 文の始めや名前などで大文字を使うきまり。授業では Nama orang dan nama tempat diawali huruf kapital.(人や場所の名前は大文字で書き始めます)
column2: The rules for using capital letters. In class: Nama orang dan nama tempat diawali huruf kapital. (Names of people and places begin with a capital letter.)

column1: 語根
column2: root (of a word)

column1: 単語の中心となる、意味のもとになる部分。授業では Kata dasar dari “pembelajaran” adalah “ajar”.(「プンブラジャラン(学習)」の語根は「アジャル(教える)」です)
column2: The core part of a word that carries its meaning. In class: Kata dasar dari “pembelajaran” adalah “ajar”. (The root of "pembelajaran" (learning) is "ajar" (teach).)

column1: 「〜される」の形。授業では “Jendela itu dipecahkan” adalah kalimat pasif.(「ジュンデラ イトゥ ディプチャカン(窓が割られた)」は受動態の文です)
column2: The "is done" form of a verb. In class: “Jendela itu dipecahkan” adalah kalimat pasif. ("Jendela itu dipecahkan" (the window was broken) is a passive sentence.)

column1: 動詞の動作を直接受けるもの。授業では Dalam kalimat “Saya membaca buku”, objeknya adalah “buku”.(「サヤ ムンバチャ ブク(私は本を読む)」の目的語は「ブク(本)」です)
column2: The thing that the action of the verb happens to. In class: Dalam kalimat “Saya membaca buku”, objeknya adalah “buku”. (In "Saya membaca buku" (I read a book), the object is "buku".)

column1: 意味が同じか近い語。授業では Cari sinonim kata ini.(この単語の類義語を見つけよう)
column2: A word with the same or a similar meaning. In class: Cari sinonim kata ini. (Find a synonym for this word.)

column1: 文章全体で筆者が伝えたいこと。授業では Apa gagasan utama paragraf ini?(この段落の要旨は何かな?)
column2: What the writer most wants to say. In class: Apa gagasan utama paragraf ini? (What is the main idea of this paragraph?)

column1: 大事なところだけを短くまとめる。授業では Ringkaslah bab itu dalam tiga kalimat.(その章を3文で要約しよう)
column2: To say only the important parts in short. In class: Ringkaslah bab itu dalam tiga kalimat. (Summarize the chapter in three sentences.)

column1: 書かれていないことを手がかりから考える。授業では Simpulan apa yang dapat kamu tarik tentang perasaan tokoh itu?(登場人物の気持ちについて何が読み取れるかな?)
column2: To work out what is not said, from clues. In class: Simpulan apa yang dapat kamu tarik tentang perasaan tokoh itu? (What can you infer about the character's feelings?)

column1: 知らない単語の意味を前後の文から考えるヒント。授業では Gunakan petunjuk konteks untuk menebak arti kata ini.(文脈の手がかりを使ってこの単語の意味を推測しよう)
column2: Hints around a new word that show its meaning. In class: Gunakan petunjuk konteks untuk menebak arti kata ini. (Use context clues to guess the meaning of this word.)

column1: 楽しませる・説明する・説得するなど、なぜ書いたか。授業では Apakah tujuan penulis untuk memberi informasi atau untuk membujuk?(筆者の目的は伝えることかな、説得することかな?)
column2: Why the writer wrote: to entertain, to inform or to persuade. In class: Apakah tujuan penulis untuk memberi informasi atau untuk membujuk? (Was the author's purpose to inform or to persuade?)

column1: 確かめられることと、人の考え。授業では Bisakah kamu membedakan fakta dan opini?(事実と意見の違いがわかるかな?)
column2: What can be checked, and what someone thinks. In class: Bisakah kamu membedakan fakta dan opini? (Can you tell the difference between fact and opinion?)

column1: 自分の答えの理由を本文から引用する。授業では Sertakan bukti dari teks untuk mendukung jawabanmu.(答えを支える根拠を本文から示そう)
column2: To quote the text to support your answer. In class: Sertakan bukti dari teks untuk mendukung jawabanmu. (Cite evidence from the text to support your answer.)

column1: 読みながら線を引いたりメモを書いたりする。授業では Buatlah catatan pada puisi itu sambil membacanya.(読みながら詩に書き込みをしよう)
column2: To underline and make notes while reading. In class: Buatlah catatan pada puisi itu sambil membacanya. (Annotate the poem as you read it.)

column1: 物語のできごとの流れ。授業では Alur cerita novel ini penuh kejutan.(この小説の筋は驚きでいっぱいだ)
column2: The order of events in a story. In class: Alur cerita novel ini penuh kejutan. (The plot of this novel is full of surprises.)

column1: 物語に出てくる人や動物。授業では Siapa tokoh utama dalam cerita ini?(物語の主人公はだれかな?)
column2: A person or animal in a story. In class: Siapa tokoh utama dalam cerita ini? (Who is the main character in the story?)

column1: 物語の時代と場所。授業では Latar ceritanya adalah sebuah desa kecil pada musim dingin.(舞台は冬の小さな村だ)
column2: When and where a story happens. In class: Latar ceritanya adalah sebuah desa kecil pada musim dingin. (The setting is a small village in winter.)

column1: 物語を通して伝わる大切な考え。授業では Tema cerita ini adalah persahabatan.(物語のテーマは友情だ)
column2: The important idea a story shows. In class: Tema cerita ini adalah persahabatan. (The theme of the story is friendship.)

column1: 物語を語っている人。授業では Narator menceritakan kisahnya sebagai orang pertama.(語り手は一人称で物語を語っている)
column2: The one who tells the story. In class: Narator menceritakan kisahnya sebagai orang pertama. (The narrator tells the story in the first person.)

column1: 登場人物がぶつかる問題。授業では Apa konflik utama dalam bab ini?(この章の中心となる対立は何かな?)
column2: The problem the characters face. In class: Apa konflik utama dalam bab ini? (What is the main conflict in this chapter?)

column1: 物語がいちばん盛り上がるところ。授業では Klimaksnya terjadi ketika sang pahlawan menghadapi naga.(主人公が竜と向き合うところがクライマックスだ)
column2: The most exciting point of a story. In class: Klimaksnya terjadi ketika sang pahlawan menghadapi naga. (The climax comes when the hero faces the dragon.)

column1: 「〜のようだ」を使わずに、何かを別のものにたとえる表現。授業では “Hidup adalah perjalanan” adalah metafora.(「人生は旅だ」は隠喩だ)
column2: Saying one thing is another thing, without "like". In class: “Hidup adalah perjalanan” adalah metafora. ("Life is a journey" is a metaphor.)

column1: エッセイ全体で言いたいことを1文で示したもの。授業では Pernyataan tesismu harus ada di paragraf pertama.(主張の文は最初の段落に入れよう)
column2: One sentence that gives the main point of an essay. In class: Pernyataan tesismu harus ada di paragraf pertama. (Your thesis statement should be in the first paragraph.)

column1: 段落の言いたいことを示す最初の文。授業では Awali setiap paragraf dengan kalimat utama yang jelas.(それぞれの段落をはっきりした中心文で始めよう)
column2: The first sentence that gives the point of a paragraph. In class: Awali setiap paragraf dengan kalimat utama yang jelas. (Start each paragraph with a clear topic sentence.)

column1: エッセイの最初の部分。授業では Tarik perhatian pembaca di bagian pendahuluan.(書き出しで読み手の心をつかもう)
column2: The first part of an essay. In class: Tarik perhatian pembaca di bagian pendahuluan. (Grab the reader's attention in your introduction.)

column1: 理由や例をくわしく書く、真ん中の段落。授業では Setiap paragraf isi memerlukan satu alasan dan satu contoh.(本論の段落にはそれぞれ理由と例が1つずつ必要だ)
column2: A middle paragraph with reasons and examples. In class: Setiap paragraf isi memerlukan satu alasan dan satu contoh. (Each body paragraph needs one reason and an example.)

column1: エッセイの最後でまとめる部分。授業では Ulangi gagasan utamamu di kesimpulan.(結論でもう一度主な主張を述べよう)
column2: The part that sums up an essay. In class: Ulangi gagasan utamamu di kesimpulan. (Restate your main point in the conclusion.)

column1: まず全体を書いてみたもの。授業では Selesaikan draf kasarmu sebelum hari Jumat.(金曜日までに下書きを終わらせよう)
column2: The first full version of a piece of writing. In class: Selesaikan draf kasarmu sebelum hari Jumat. (Finish your rough draft by Friday.)

column1: 内容や構成をよくするために書き直す。授業では Revisi karanganmu setelah mendapat masukan.(意見をもらったらエッセイを書き直そう)
column2: To rewrite to make the content better. In class: Revisi karanganmu setelah mendapat masukan. (Revise your essay after you get feedback.)

column1: つづりや句読点のまちがいを確かめる。授業では Koreksi dengan teliti kesalahan ejaan.(つづりのまちがいがないか注意して校正しよう)
column2: To check for spelling and punctuation mistakes. In class: Koreksi dengan teliti kesalahan ejaan. (Proofread carefully for spelling mistakes.)

column1: 書く前に段落の順番や内容を決めたメモ。授業では Buatlah kerangka karangan sebelum mulai menulis.(書き始める前にアウトラインを作ろう)
column2: A plan of the paragraphs before writing. In class: Buatlah kerangka karangan sebelum mulai menulis. (Make an outline before you start writing.)
